title: Version 1.9.0
body:
Version 1.9.0

June 22nd, 2023

New Content:

  • Added the ability to purchase multiple structures in one box

Changes:

  • Boxed water no longer takes oxygen away
  • Boxed water's default size is now correct

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed purchased doors still showing their price
  • Removed accidentally placed development models
  • Fixed issue with grabby grabber not moving some objects

Version 1.9.1

June 22nd, 2023

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed increase and decrease content showing on non-structure boxes
